s.how: Cook 3 sliced onions slowly with a spoon of brown sugar and thyme for 30 minutes. Cut shortcrust into rounds and press into a patty tin. Bake at 190C for 12 minutes, then fill with the onions and a piece of goat's cheese and bake 5 more minutes.

s.note: Bridget's capers in her birthday menu
s.how: Slice a baguette and toast until golden. Spread with cream cheese, top with folds of smoked salmon, a scatter of capers and a little lemon zest. Serve on a plate at a dinner party where at least one thing will go badly.

m.note: the leek soup that turns blue from the string
m.how: Slice 3 leeks and soften in butter with 500g diced potatoes. Add 1L chicken stock and simmer 25 minutes, then blend smooth with 150ml cream. Serve with crusty bread. Tie the leeks with kitchen twine, not blue string.

w.note: the orange marmalade on Bridget's birthday menu
w.how: Spoon 4 tbsp orange marmalade into a greased pudding basin. Beat 125g butter with 125g sugar, add 2 eggs and fold in 175g self-raising flour. Spoon on top, cover tightly and steam for 90 minutes. Turn out and serve with hot custard.

d.how: Chill a bottle of chardonnay in the fridge for a couple of hours. Pour a generous glass for anyone writing in a diary tonight. For non-drinkers, pour cold sparkling apple juice into the same glasses.
